Tragedy struck on 2 June 2023 near Balasore, Odisha, as a devastating incident unfolded. The unfortunate event involved a collision between three trains, namely the Coromandel Express and the SMVT Bengaluru–Howrah SF Express, triggered by an initial accident involving a goods train near the Bahanaga Bazar station. The repercussions were severe, with a staggering loss of life, as several hundred individuals perished, while over a thousand others suffered injuries. In this informative video, we delve into the details of the Odisha incident, exploring its causes and shedding light on its underlying factors. Additionally, we thoroughly examine reports from the Indian Railways, including those from the IR, CAG, and CBI, aiming to uncover the systemic issues plaguing the railway network. By meticulously analyzing these reports, we strive to gain a comprehensive understanding of the root causes contributing to the railway mishaps in India. Through this reimagined narrative, we provide a fresh perspective on the tragic event, finding answers to questions like How did this incident take place? Why did this tragedy happen? What went wrong? And much more.
